title: Storey Architecture rise
description: A wrapper that lifts its content 28px into place and fades it in over the first stretch of scroll after it enters the window (CSS view timeline). Steps stagger paragraphs that sit side by side.
notes: CSS only: browsers without scroll-driven animations, and reduced motion, show the content in place
the original masks each line separately; this moves the whole block
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box (use overflow-clip), or the timeline freezes
